posts.name: cranny777
posts.cooked:
My first forum post. Relatively nervous. Nice to meet all of you. 

On the Kickstarter page -- which I happily supported as my first Kickstart pledge ever :) -- I noticed that the Oblivaeon add-on will include

  • A "Mission" deck full of quests the heroes embark on to gain allies and tools to aid them in the conflict!

Any word on what "mission deck" means? 

Will we be able to use these with other villains or only with Oblivaeon, Aeon and Scions?

What I'm really wondering is ... Can I use mission decks in an old-fashioned fight between Baron Blade and Legacy, Absolute Zero, the Wraith, Tachyon and Bunker?

Thanks for reading.

posts.name: saykhia
posts.cooked:
I am guessing they are OblivAeon only. Allowing their rewards in normal games would probably lead to drastic imbalance - but perfectly suited for games involving exchanges of 5000 irreducible damage.

From what GTG has said they are probably cards with objectives on one side (analogous to Warfang’s Title Deck), which when completed and flipped over reveals rewards (like that gawdhueg cannon in a recent art stream).
